publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for asset metadata, upload-intent, completion, content-read, delete, and cleanup routes.
Public asset seam for future consuming features to validate, read, and link assets without importing storage or persistence internals.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing asset lifecycle, upload-intent binding, or storage-key immutability semantics can make uploaded bytes usable without the approved verification path.
Changing same-origin private content-read behavior can leak storage authority or bypass asset-native authorization.
Changing validation seam semantics can let consuming features replace entity authorization with generic asset ownership.
